source.title: Details of the Cloudflare outage on July 2, 2019

auditedFacts.fact: A WAF rule containing a catastrophic-backtracking regular expression exhausted CPUs serving HTTP and HTTPS traffic globally.
auditedFacts.location: postmortem sections describing the cause and CPU saturation

auditedFacts.fact: The emergency rollback restored service after a 27-minute global outage.
Functional WAF tests covered blocking behavior but did not measure the rule's CPU cost under adversarial input.
Rapid global rule deployment amplified a locally introduced defect, and the postmortem enumerates eleven contributing conditions.

claimBoundary: This snapshot establishes a real semantic-correctness-versus-resource-complexity failure and its testing blind spot. It does not establish benchmark difficulty, candidate fairness, or agent failure.
